questions.question: Which Montgomery census tracts had the most code violations in 2025?

questions.question: Which Montgomery census tracts had the most code violations per 1,000 residents in 2025?
questions.answer_shape: Descending rates plus counts, total-resident denominators, population vintage and missing or zero-denominator handling.

questions.question: Do Montgomery census tracts with more code violations this year also have more adults with high blood pressure?

questions.question: Which Montgomery tracts had the biggest increase in code violations from 2024 to 2025?

questions.question: How many Montgomery code violations have been recorded each month so far in 2026?

questions.question: Which Montgomery census tracts had the most 311 service requests in 2025?

questions.question: What were the most common types of Montgomery 311 requests in 2025?

questions.question: Do Montgomery tracts with more 311 requests per 1,000 residents also have more code violations per 1,000 residents in 2025?

questions.question: Which Montgomery tracts have the most food establishments with a latest inspection score below 85?

questions.question: Which Montgomery census tracts contain listed emergency shelters?

questions.question: Which Montgomery census tracts had the most building permits issued in 2025?
